messages:
maria: Heads-up — hitting a weird HF->Redwood conversion bug with an inline aux marker in a jinja chat_template. model bring-up eval failing because assistant turns are being squashed.

chris: can you paste a minimal snippet and the converted rw prompt?

maria: sure. original hf chat_template (simplified):

```
{% macro aux_note() -%}
[AUX: do not include in output]
{%- endmacro %}

[INST]{{system}}\n
{{- aux_note() -}}\n
{{# user }}User prompt here{{/ user }}\n[/INST]
```

after our hf->redwood conversion step the rendered prompt ends up with the aux block inlined without a sentinel and the assistant role becomes empty: assistant messages get merged into the preceding user tokens and kv-cache alignment is off.

devon: ugh. is the aux macro using a raw block or any special tokens? looks like the converter strips the macro but not the trailing newline/sentinel.

maria: no raw block. It's an inline macro that returns a bracketed tag. The tokenizer treats `[` and `]` as normal tokens but our conversion removes the jinja markers and doesn't emit the Redwood sentinel for hidden metadata. Example converted (bad):

```
System: <system text> User: User prompt here [AUX: do not include in output]
```

expected converted (good):

```
System: <system text> <|aux|>[AUX: do not include in output]<|/aux|>
User: User prompt here
```

chris: ah ok. so the converter needs to preserve aux blocks as non-consumable sentinel tokens, not inline literal text. otherwise kv-cache and role splitting break. did you repro as a tokenization delta?

alex: i ran a quick token-diff on the model we onboarded (gpt-like open checkpoint) — token count +3 and generation shifted earlier 1 token causing eval ROUGE drop ~0.7 pts. small but consistent on our regression set.

maria: repro steps: 1) render jinja template 2) run hf->rw converter 3) compare role-segmentation and tokens via tokenizer.encode 4) feed to runtime simulator. I can attach snippets.

devon: workaround for now: detect macro results that match our aux pattern (regex `^\[AUX:.*\]$`) and wrap in explicit sentinels before passing to converter. quick sed: `sed -E 's/\[AUX:(.*?)\]/<|aux|>[AUX:\1]<|/aux|>/g'` — not ideal but will normalize.

chris: long-term fix: converter should preserve jinja non-rendered placeholders or translate macro outputs used for metadata into sentinel tokens. Also add a unit test: jinja template with inline macro -> expected sentinel-wrapped metadata in rw prompt.

alex: adding to onboarding checklist: run token-diff + kv-cache alignment smoke on every hf->rw conversion. put a tiny eval (3 prompts) that fails fast.

maria: one more gotcha: when aux block is at end of a system block the converter currently trims the trailing newline making the next message merge. so need to ensure explicit newline and sentinel boundaries are enforced.

infra-bot: CI pipeline: created issue #inference-converter-432, attached logs from maria.

devon: I'll push a small patch to the converter to wrap detected metadata with sentinels and add tests. cc @chris for review.

chris: thanks — after patch let's run the quantized eval (int8) too; quantization can amplify these token boundary issues.

maria: cool. i also left a sample failing prompt in the repro gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/repro-aux-jinja (private).

alex: once patched i'll re-run the bring-up regression harness. if we see <0.5 ROUGE delta we're good to proceed.

maria: thx — will update thread when patch lands. :thumbsup:
